title: Phaseout compatibility bridge and Pin Suggester for legacy model versions
creator: Aisha Chen
description: Design and deliver a lightweight compatibility bridge plus an automated 'Pin Suggester' that helps customers migrate away from soon-to-be-deprecated model versions. The feature should reduce customer lift for migrations by surfacing pin recommendations, compat flags, and expected cost/latency deltas in the Console and via API warnings.
background: We frequently retire older model weights or architecture variants to reduce maintenance and storage burden. Current deprecation notices are one-way emails and console banners; customers ask for more concrete migration help, especially when pinning behavior and latency/cost trade-offs are non-obvious. This initiative creates a structured migration assistant coupled with a compatibility bridge that can run shim transformations where safe (e.g., tokenizer normalization, prompt templates).
success_criteria: Pin Suggester shows recommendations for >= 85% of affected customers during rollout window
Post-migration error rate attributable to model incompatibility decreases by 60% for customers using suggestions
Average time-to-pin (customer completes pin after initial suggestion) <= 14 days
No P0 incidents in the migration rollout for first 2 weeks
acceptance_criteria: Console UI surfaces a clear migration card with recommended target model, estimated token latency delta, and cost delta
API deprecation warning includes programmatic field 'recommended_pin' and 'compatibility_risk'
Compatibility bridge implements tokenizer normalization and prompt padding shim with feature-flag control
Telemetry emits events: migration_suggestion_sent, migration_pin_applied, compat_bridge_fallback
Migration template email and in-console CTA approved by legal and support
scope_included: Pin Suggester backend scoring and recommendation rules
Console migration card and CTA flow
API deprecation header with recommended_pin field
Compatibility bridge prototype limited to text-generation models (not embeddings)
out_of_scope: Automatic forced rerouting of customer traffic without explicit opt-in
Cross-model architecture conversions that require retraining
Embedding model deprecations in this iteration
rollout_plan: Week 1: Internal alpha - product, eng, and support use the Suggester for a small set of deprecated models
Week 2: Beta with 10% of affected customers via invitation; collect telemetry and feedback
Week 3-4: Gradual expansion and enable in-console migration card for all customers with a soft notice
Week 5: Official deprecation notice + recommended pin becomes default suggestion; monitor metrics and enable manual compat bridge for opt-in customers
Rollback criteria: >5% increase in model-error telemetry or customer support escalations above threshold
communication_templates: In-console card: 'Action recommended: Pin to model X.Y for continued compatibility. Estimated latency +6ms, cost +0.8%.' with single-click pin and 'preview differences' link.
Email template: Subject 'Action recommended: Migrate off model abc-2023 by 2025-05-15' with steps, expected deltas, and support contact.
API warning: 'Deprecation notice: model abc-2023 will be retired. recommended_pin: abc-2024, compatibility_risk: low|medium|high'
migration_guidance_summary: Provide a migration checklist: run compatibility diagnostics (auto-run via Console), preview 5 canonical prompts against recommended model, verify latency/cost trade-offs in a staging route, apply pin, and schedule rollback window. Include sample SDK snippets for pinning and a script template to compare tokenization outputs.
qa_checks: End-to-end flow: suggestion -> preview -> pin -> verification succeeds on staging
Api header asserts recommended_pin present and returns expected risk score
Compatibility bridge toggled off: behavior should fall back to preexisting deprecation banner
Load test: backend scoring responds within 120ms for 99th percentile
followups: ENG: implement finer-grained risk scoring using prompt set mismatch statistics (post-launch backlog)
PM: synthesize migration telemetry into an automated 'migration health' dashboard
Support: update KB articles and playbooks to include quick fixes for common incompatibilities
